nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$ and let $a$, $d$ be integers with $0 < d \le a$. Then the equation $a x^{m+2} + (a - d) x^{m+1} - (a + (m + 1)d) x - (a + md) = 0$ has exactly one positive real solution, and every positive real solution $x$ satisfies $x > 1$.
nodes.title: The auxiliary equation has a unique positive root, which exceeds $1$

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$, let $a$, $d$ be positive integers with $m^2 d^2 < 8a$, and let $\lambda > 0$ be a real number with $a \lambda^{m+2} + (a - d) \lambda^{m+1} - (a + (m + 1)d) \lambda - (a + md) = 0$. Then $\lfloor a \lambda^p \rfloor = a + pd - 1$ for every integer $p$ with $1 \le p \le m - 1$.
nodes.title: Exact floors at powers of the auxiliary root (all exponents)

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$, let $a$, $d$ be positive integers, and let $p$ be an integer with $1 \le p \le m - 1$ and $p(m - p)d^2 < 2a$. If $\lambda > 0$ is a real number with $a \lambda^{m+2} + (a - d) \lambda^{m+1} - (a + (m + 1)d) \lambda - (a + md) = 0$, then $\lfloor a \lambda^p \rfloor = a + pd - 1$.
nodes.title: Exact floor at a power of the auxiliary root (single exponent)

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$, let $a$, $d$ be natural numbers with $d > 0$ and $(m + 1)d < 2a$, and let $\lambda > 0$ be a real number with $a \lambda^{m+2} + (a - d) \lambda^{m+1} - (a + (m + 1)d) \lambda - (a + md) = 0$. Then $\lfloor a \lambda^p \rfloor < a + pd$ for every integer $p$ with $1 \le p \le m - 1$.
nodes.title: Strict upper bound on floors at powers of the auxiliary root

nodes.summary: Let $a$, $d$ be coprime integers with $0 < d \le a$. Then the polynomial $a x^4 + (a + d) x^3 + (a + 2d) x^2 + (a + 3d) x + (a + 4d)$ is not the product of two polynomials of degree $2$ in $\mathbb{Z}[x]$.
nodes.title: The arithmetic-progression quartic is not a product of two quadratics

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$ with $m + 1$ prime, and let $a$, $d$ be coprime positive integers. Suppose $d$ has a prime divisor $p$ that is not divisible by $m + 1$ and whose residue modulo $m + 1$ has multiplicative order $m$ (that is, $p$ is a primitive root modulo $m + 1$). Then the polynomial $a x^m + (a + d) x^{m-1} + \cdots + (a + (m - 1)d) x + (a + md)$ is irreducible in $\mathbb{Z}[x]$.
nodes.title: Irreducibility when $d$ has a primitive-root prime factor

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$ and let $a$, $d$ be coprime positive integers with $m^2 d^2 < 8a$. Then the polynomial $a x^m + (a + d) x^{m-1} + \cdots + (a + (m - 1)d) x + (a + md)$ is irreducible in $\mathbb{Z}[x]$.
nodes.title: Irreducibility of polynomials with coefficients in an arithmetic progression

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$, let $a$, $d$ be integers with $0 < d \le a$, and let $\lambda > 0$ be a real number with $a \lambda^{m+2} + (a - d) \lambda^{m+1} - (a + (m + 1)d) \lambda - (a + md) = 0$. Then $a + md < a \lambda^m$.
